description.zh: 点击标题后内容区在高度方向展开或收起，像手风琴风箱。 关键是用 grid-template-rows 从 0fr 到 1fr 的高度动画， 让内容"推开来"而不是瞬间出现， 同时箭头旋转呼应状态。
description.en: Tapping a header expands or collapses the content vertically, like a bellows. The crux is animating grid-template-rows from 0fr to 1fr so content unfolds instead of popping in, with the chevron rotating in sync.

use_when.zh: FAQ、设置分组、详情页补充信息
use_when.en: FAQs, grouped settings, supplementary detail sections

use_when.zh: 长页面需要折叠低优先级内容
同组内容一次只看一个（互斥手风琴）
use_when.en: Exclusive sections — one open at a time

avoid_when.zh: 用户需要对比多个展开项（互斥会烦）
avoid_when.en: Comparing several sections open at once

avoid_when.zh: 内容超过两屏（滚动比折叠更自然）
avoid_when.en: Content over two screens — scrolling beats folding

avoid_when.zh: 关键操作路径上的步骤（隐藏即摩擦）
avoid_when.en: Critical steps in a flow — hiding adds friction

note.zh: 同时只开一项，经典手风琴
note.en: One open at a time — the classic accordion

note.zh: 各项独立开合，适合并列内容

notes.zh: 现代纯 CSS 法：外层 display:grid，grid-template-rows 在 0fr 与 1fr 间过渡（300ms）， 内层 min-height:0 + overflow:hidden。 免去 JS 测量高度。 展开/收起方向一致；箭头 rotate 90/180 同步过渡； 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion 改为瞬时切换。
notes.en: Modern CSS recipe — outer display:grid with grid-template-rows transitioning between 0fr and 1fr (300ms), inner min-height:0 plus overflow:hidden. No height measuring needed. Keep expand/collapse symmetric; rotate the chevron 90/180 in sync; under prefers-reduced-motion switch instantly.

basic.zh: 给 FAQ 列表添加手风琴展开效果：点击标题展开答案，再点收起。
basic.en: Add accordion expand to the FAQ — tapping a header reveals the answer, tapping again collapses it.

design.zh: FAQ 项点击后答案在 300ms 内由 0fr 展开到 1fr，箭头同步旋转 180°；同组互斥，一次只开一项；展开不跳页。
design.en: On tap, the answer unfolds from 0fr to 1fr within 300ms while the chevron rotates 180°; sections are mutually exclusive — one open at a time; no page jump.

implementation.zh: 外层 grid + grid-template-rows: 0fr/1fr 过渡 300ms，内层 overflow:hidden + min-height:0。React 里用 useState 存展开 id，互斥取单值。加 aria-expanded 与按钮语义；reduced-motion 直接切换。
implementation.en: Outer grid with grid-template-rows 0fr/1fr transition over 300ms, inner overflow:hidden + min-height:0. Store the open id in useState; mutual exclusion means a single value. Add aria-expanded and button semantics; switch instantly under reduced-motion.

agent.zh:
为项目 FAQ 区添加手风琴展开动效。

先检查现有 accordion/折叠组件，避免重复实现。
要求：
- grid-template-rows 0fr→1fr 高度动画，300ms
- 同组互斥（可配置多开），箭头同步旋转
- aria-expanded 正确、键盘可操作
- 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion
- 不引入新依赖
完成后运行现有检查，说明修改文件。
agent.en:
Add accordion expand motion to the project's FAQ section.

Check existing accordion/collapse components first; avoid duplicating them.
Requirements:
- grid-template-rows 0fr→1fr height animation, 300ms
- Mutually exclusive within a group (multi-open configurable), chevron in sync
- Correct aria-expanded and keyboard operability
- Respect prefers-reduced-motion
- No new dependencies
Run existing checks when done and list modified files.
